meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自定义 AI 该记住哪些内容,按领域打标签并推送提醒
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 按自己的领域习惯记住要点并在关键记忆上收到提醒
copy.tagline_en: Customize what your assistant remembers, tag notes by domain, and fire alerts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to remember domain notes and alert you on key ones.

howto.what: 它会先问你在做什么工作，和你一起定一套笔记分类（观察类型和概念标签），生成并安装成自定义 claude-mem 模式，可选配 Telegram 提醒，重启 worker 并验证模式已生效。
howto.when: 当你想自定义 claude-mem 记住什么、新建或修改模式、添加观察类型或标签等时候触发，哪怕你没说「模式」这个词。

say.text: 帮我建一个自定义模式，我主要做法律案例研究
say.note: 它会先问你做什么，再一起定分类

say.text: 给这个模式加两个观察类型：设计决策和客户偏好
say.note: 写好后先校验，再安装并重启

say.text: 记录事故复盘时，给我发 Telegram 通知
say.note: 需先配好 Telegram bot 凭据

howto.what_en: It interviews you about your work, proposes a small note taxonomy (observation types and concept tags), installs it as a custom claude-mem mode, optionally sets up Telegram alerts, restarts the worker and verifies the mode is active.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, add observation types or tags, and more, even if you don't say "mode."

say_en.text: Create a custom mode for me — I mostly do legal case research
say_en.note: It asks about your work, then defines categories

say_en.text: Add two observation types: design decisions and client preferences
say_en.note: It validates first, then installs and restarts

say_en.text: Send a Telegram alert when an incident retro is recorded
